item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Old-fashioned breaded pork patties with boiled white potatoes and classic creamed peas and carrots, topped with freshly chopped parsley. With pickled beetroot and shaken lingonberries. Also served gluten free. (1+2+6+11+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Greek lemon- and oregano-marinated chicken served with oven-baked Greek lemon potatoes and grilled peppers, topped with fresh oregano and crumbled feta. With creamy tzatziki and olives. Gluten free. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Greek lemon- and oregano-marinated portobello mushrooms served with oven-baked Greek lemon potatoes and grilled peppers, topped with fresh oregano and vegan feta. With creamy vegan tzatziki and olives. Gluten free. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Classic Danish meatballs in curry served with rice, raisins and salted peanuts – straight off the open road. (1+4+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu in a mild curry sauce served with rice, raisins and salted peanuts. (4+6+7+11+15) — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Pasta with meatballs in a deep, flavourful tomato sauce. (1+6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pasta with vegetable meatballs in a deep, flavourful tomato sauce. (1+6+13+15) — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: American Thanksgiving – roasted turkey cuvette with oven-baked potatoes, cream sauce and roasted Brussels sprouts with parsley, topped with crushed walnuts. With cranberry-apple sauce, sage and thyme stuffing and glazed carrot. Also served gluten free. (1+2+6+9+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish American Thanksgiving – whole-roasted celeriac with oven-baked potatoes, cream sauce and roasted Brussels sprouts with parsley, topped with crushed walnuts. With cranberry-apple sauce, sage and thyme stuffing and glazed carrot. Also served gluten free and vegan. (1+2+6+9+10+13+15) — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
